messages:
maria: quick flag - customer reported rerank failures after we flipped on the new batching helper in sampleapp-canary
maria: error log from their service:
```
RuntimeError: tensor size mismatch: expected 768 got 1536
at rerank_client.py:42
```
kevin: ugh. did they mix clients/versions?
maria: yes, they have a few services running older python-sampleapp and one new node-sampleapp with the helper enabled
QA-Lena: what does the batching helper do differently?
kevin: it pads embeddings to the batch max to avoid dynamic reallocs. Node change made pad=true the default; python stayed false. so embeddings lengths diverge at ingestion time
ops-ron: also saw weird auth retry noise in the logs - a burst of 401->refresh->200 that caused the embed client to resend a batch twice, producing duplicates with different padding states
maria: repro steps I ran locally:
1) node sdk 0.7.1 set batcher.pad_to_max = true -> embeddings length 1536
2) python sdk 0.5.9 default pad_to_max=false -> embeddings length 768
3) call /v1/rerank with mixed candidate_embeddings -> failure
kevin: can you paste a minimal failing payload?
maria: sure:
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query_embedding": [0.01, ...]  # len 1536
  "candidate_embeddings": [ [0.02, ...] , [0.03, ...] ] # mix of len 768 and 1536
}
```
QA-Lena: note: rerank server expects a uniform embedding_dim in the request, and our JSON schema doesn't validate that currently
kevin: short-term mitigation: sampleapp hotfix that validates embedding lengths before sending and surface a clear error like: 
"embedding_dim mismatch: expected 768 but saw 1536; check SDK pad_to_max parity"
sdk-bot: opened issue RED-embed-317 with labels: devex, sdk-parity, high
ops-ron: for the auth/retry dupes I think the embedding client retry logic should be idempotent. either add an idempotency_token per batch or make retry be client-only (no resend if token refresh happened mid-request)
maria: added a quick assert and idempotency header in sampleapp PR: github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/420 - ci passing locally
kevin: long-term proposals: (a) include "embedding_dim" in embedding response metadata, (b) standardize pad_to_max default in SDKs, (c) rerank endpoint to validate dims and return structured error: {"code":"EMB_DIM_MISMATCH","message":"..."}
QA-Lena: also add a small integration test where we run both sdks concurrently and call rerank to catch cross-client regressions in CI
ops-ron: tied to that - add logging on server side to include client sdk version and pad flag in request logs (PII-safe) so support can triage faster
maria: notified customer and rolled the assert as an emergency deploy, they report error stopped. I'll follow up with a writeup for on-call runbook
kevin: I'll take the SDK parity task to change defaults and add embedding_dim to responses. tagging @QA-Lena for tests
sdk-bot: assigned RED-embed-317 to kevin, due: 2026-04-02
maria: thanks team :pray:
